ideas.pitch: An automated GitHub PR reviewer and document verification agent designed specifically to handle student submissions for the 3SVK ecosystem.
ideas.title: 3SVK Cloud-Native Research Audit Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the organizing body's explicit evaluation workflow (GitHub review, code audit, document verification) solves an immediate operational bottleneck for the 3SVK platform team.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that classifies and indexes student innovation proposals to match them with relevant enterprise research tracks.
ideas.title: Student Research Semantic Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of kNN-over-exemplar semantic routing to provide instant categorization for thousands of submissions in the 3SVK portal.

ideas.pitch: A visual workflow orchestration tool for validating multi-stage student research submissions and pre-deployment code checks.
ideas.title: BPMN Research Pipeline Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven BPMN agentic orchestration patterns to streamline technical review auditing for hackathon organizers.

ideas.pitch: A Kubernetes-backed registry and MCP server setup to securely federate and index student research datasets across cloud platforms.
ideas.title: Federated Student Innovation Registry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the 3SVK platform's scaling goals as a national student cloud and AI initiative.

ideas.pitch: An auto-embedding research toolkit that ingests student project documentation and creates lightning-fast searchable indexes for judges.
ideas.title: TOON-Native Auto-Embedding Research Index
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an immediate, high-utility utility for judges wading through thousands of submissions on the 3SVK platform.
